document.querySelectorAll('.wrap-logos .logos').forEach(function (logos) {
  var track = logos.querySelector('.logos__track');
  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children);
  var prev  = logos.querySelector('.logos__btn--prev');
  var next  = logos.querySelector('.logos__btn--next');  
  var index = 0;

  track.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

  var isDown = false, startX = 0, dragDelta = 0, baseTranslate = 0, moved = false;

  function perView() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 600) return 2;
    if (w <= 900) return 3;
    return 5;
  }
  function stepSize() {
    var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 0;
    return items[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
  }
  function maxIndex() {
    return Math.max(0, items.length - perView());
  }
  function setTranslate(x) {
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)';
  }
  function update() {
    if (index > maxIndex()) index = maxIndex();
    if (index < 0) index = 0;
    baseTranslate = -index * stepSize();
    setTranslate(baseTranslate);
    prev.disabled = index === 0;
    next.disabled = index >= maxIndex();
  }

  prev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    index = Math.max(0, index - perView());
    update();
  });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    index = Math.min(maxIndex(), index + perView());
    update();
  });

  track.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    isDown = true;
    moved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    dragDelta = 0;
    baseTranslate = -index * stepSize();
  });

  track.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!isDown) return;
    dragDelta = e.clientX - startX;

    if (!moved && Math.abs(dragDelta) > 5) {
      moved = true;
      track.classList.add('is-dragging');
      if (track.setPointerCapture) track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    }

    if (moved) setTranslate(baseTranslate + dragDelta);
  });

  function endDrag() {
    if (!isDown) return;
    isDown = false;
    track.classList.remove('is-dragging');
    var moveBy = Math.round(-dragDelta / stepSize());
    index = Math.min(maxIndex(), Math.max(0, index + moveBy));
    update();
  }
  track.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  track.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);

  items.forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (moved) e.preventDefault();
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  update();
});

    function getLive(tempo) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",

                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,

                    } else {

            });

    /* --- Estilo dos itens (igual ao original) --- */
    .item-box {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        z-index: 1;
        transition: color 0.3s ease-in-out;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    .item-box .icon-full { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

    .item-box::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
        height: 0;
        transition: height 0.3s ease-in-out;
        z-index: -1;
    }

    function getLive(tempo) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: window.defaultUrl + 'home/getLives',
                timeout: 3000,
                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,
                error: function() {

                },
                success: function(retorno) {
                    if (retorno.live.id !== undefined || retorno.live.id !== '') {
                        $('#iFrameFixVideo').attr('src', 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + retorno.live.id );
                        $('#container-video').show();
                    } else {
                        $('#container-video').hide();
                    }
                    getLive(600000);
                }
            });
        }, tempo)
    }

        getLive(5000);

document.querySelectorAll('.wrap-logos .logos').forEach(function (logos) {
  var track = logos.querySelector('.logos__track');
  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children);
  var prev  = logos.querySelector('.logos__btn--prev');
  var next  = logos.querySelector('.logos__btn--next');  
  var index = 0;

  track.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

  var isDown = false, startX = 0, dragDelta = 0, baseTranslate = 0, moved = false;

  function perView() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 600) return 2;
    if (w <= 900) return 3;
    return 5;
  }
  function stepSize() {
    var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 0;
    return items[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
  }
  function maxIndex() {
    return Math.max(0, items.length - perView());
  }
  function setTranslate(x) {
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)';
  }
  function update() {
    if (index > maxIndex()) index = maxIndex();
    if (index < 0) index = 0;
    baseTranslate = -index * stepSize();
    setTranslate(baseTranslate);
    prev.disabled = index === 0;
    next.disabled = index >= maxIndex();
  }

  prev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    index = Math.max(0, index - perView());
    update();
  });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    index = Math.min(maxIndex(), index + perView());
    update();
  });

  track.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    isDown = true;
    moved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    dragDelta = 0;
    baseTranslate = -index * stepSize();
  });

  track.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!isDown) return;
    dragDelta = e.clientX - startX;

    if (!moved && Math.abs(dragDelta) > 5) {
      moved = true;
      track.classList.add('is-dragging');
      if (track.setPointerCapture) track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    }

    if (moved) setTranslate(baseTranslate + dragDelta);
  });

  function endDrag() {
    if (!isDown) return;
    isDown = false;
    track.classList.remove('is-dragging');
    var moveBy = Math.round(-dragDelta / stepSize());
    index = Math.min(maxIndex(), Math.max(0, index + moveBy));
    update();
  }
  track.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  track.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);

  items.forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (moved) e.preventDefault();
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  update();
});

                datatype: 'JSON',
                cache: false,

                        $('#container-video').show();
                    } else {
                        $('#container-video').hide();
                    }
                    getLive(600000);
                }
            });
        }, tempo)
    }
